[FACT] User recently bought a Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra for $1,200.  
[FACT] User's Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra has 16GB RAM and 512GB storage variant.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for a new phone case for their Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their new Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant clarified that the phone's RAM and storage capacity do not affect the compatibility of phone cases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several brands for phone cases: OtterBox, Spigen, Case-Mate, Samsung, UAG, Tech21, and Incipio.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided specific models from each brand, such as OtterBox Defender Series, Spigen Rugged Armor, and Samsung Silicone Case.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised the user to check the compatibility of the case with the phone's model number (SM-S908B, SM-S908U, or SM-S908W) and verify the seller's return policy.  
[PREFERENCE] User did not know that RAM and storage wouldn't affect case compatibility and thanked the assistant for clarifying.  
[FACT] User has an old iPhone 11 from which they want to transfer data to their new S22 Ultra.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for transferring data from iPhone 11 to S22 Ultra using Smart Switch, Move to Android, and iCloud/Google Drive methods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed steps for each method, including downloading apps and selecting data to transfer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested additional tips for the transfer process, such as ensuring both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network and considering third-party apps for iMessage history.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several tips for optimizing battery life, including adjusting screen settings, managing apps, and using a dark theme.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested lowering screen brightness, reducing screen timeout, and closing unused apps.
